name: IkaIka Portal Backend
title: IkaIka Portal Backend
description: The Laravel API behind the Ikaika portal - decoupled-script 1.39.3

build-release.description: Builds the API's release archive, deployment/out/central-platform.zip, for staging or production: deployment/build.ps1 with the public folder the target serves it from, which Vite bakes into every font URL

args.label: -Bump   [String]
args.description: The version to build as, as the estimator's build-release takes it: keep, patch, minor, major or an explicit x.y.z, bumped in VERSION...

args.label: -Tag   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: With a -Bump, file the changelog under the new version, commit and tag it on Bitbucket once the build is good - tag-version.

args.label: -FromTag   [String]
args.description: Rebuild this tag as it was, for staging: its sources in a worktree of their own.

args.label: -Deploy   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Upload to the server once the build (and the tag) is good: server/deploy-release, which installs it with deploy-admin.sh.

args.label: -DryRun   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: With -Deploy, name what would go up and run, and send nothing.

args.label: -Clean   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: With -Deploy, remove the server's older release backups and a failed deploy's leftovers once the new release is in.

args.label: -Keep   [Int32]
args.description: How many release copies dist/ keeps; older ones are pruned.

args.label: -FixTarget   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: When the target is not set up, fill in what check-targets can derive from its deploy config and the server, then build.

args.label: -AllowDirty   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: With a -Bump, build over uncommitted changes, which the version's tag would then not hold.

args.label: -Gui   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: The estimator backend's Build release dialog, instead of running with these switches.

check-targets.description: Checks that staging and production can be built and deployed, and fills in what is missing from what is already known - the checker build-release consults before it refuses a target, and fixes with when asked (-FixTarget, or its prompt)

args.label: -Target   [String]
args.description: Which target to check: staging (debug.*), production (release.*), or both.

args.label: -Fix   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Write every value that can be derived.

args.label: -Offline   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Check the files against each other only; no SSH to the server and no request to the API.

ci-check.description: Plays the Build release workflow through this checkout, so a change to the workflow, a ci-* script, secrets.json or the toolkit pin fails here and not on a GitHub runner

args.label: -Online   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Also ask GitHub whether every secret the workflow reads exists, with git's stored github.com credential; no value is ever read.

ci-local.description: Plays the Build release workflow on this PC, for when GitHub Actions cannot: the same choices, planned by the same ci-release-plan.ps1, then each step's work run here

args.label: -Target   [String]
args.description: staging is the Bluehost Test Server; production is refused until ikaika_scripts.env names one.

args.label: -ConfirmProduction   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Yes, upload to PRODUCTION - a production upload needs it, as the form's box does.

args.label: -Version   [String]
args.description: same rebuilds as is, keep takes the next build number, patch/minor/major bump and tag; an explicit x.y.z is a custom version.

args.label: -BuildFrom   [String]
args.description: Rebuild this tag as it was, for staging, as the form's build_from does.

args.label: -Upload   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Upload to the server after packaging: composer, the swap, migrations, then the health check.

args.label: -NoGitHub   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Leave GitHub alone: no version commit or tag pushed there.

args.label: -PlanOnly   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Plan, and print what each phase would run; nothing is run, and no secret is read.

development-setup.description: Prepares a freshly installed Windows machine to develop the Ikaika portal API: WampServer with PHP 8.4 and MySQL 8.0, Composer, the PHP extensions Laravel needs, and this repository's own dependencies

args.label: -Report   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Grade everything and stop. Nothing is downloaded, installed or written.

args.label: -Force   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Run composer install even when composer.lock has not changed since the last run.

args.label: -ToolsOnly   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Stop after the machine is ready, without touching this repository.

args.label: -MachineOnly   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: The machine-wide half alone - VC++ runtimes, WampServer, its add-ons, php.ini - and then stop.

env-file.description: Browses and edits this repository's .env, beside the .env.example it is supposed to match - which key is missing, which is empty, which is set to something the example never mentioned, and what each one actually holds

args.label: -Show   [String]
args.description: Which keys to list. A fact about the command rather than about this machine, so it is a ValidateSet and reaches the app as a dropdown.

args.label: -Reveal   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Show values in the clear.

environment-variables.description: Points this machine's PATH at whichever PHP, MySQL and Apache WampServer is currently set to serve, so php, composer and mysql work in any terminal without a full path

args.label: -Report   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Print what WampServer has selected and what PATH would become, and stop.

args.label: -Direct   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Write the literal directories instead of %WAMP_PHP% and friends.

run-servers.description: Starts and stops the servers this project develops against: WampServer's Apache and MySQL, phpMyAdmin in a browser, the Laravel API, and the Vite asset build

args.label: -WampServer   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Start WampServer itself - wampmanager.exe, the tray application - and let it bring up Apache and the database the way it does when a person...

args.label: -Apache   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: WampServer's Apache, as a Windows service.

args.label: -MySQL   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: WampServer's MySQL service.

args.label: -MariaDB   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: WampServer's MariaDB service. Separate from MySQL on purpose - they are two servers on two ports, and this project runs one of them.

args.label: -PhpMyAdmin   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Open phpMyAdmin in the browser, starting Apache first if it is not up.

args.label: -Api   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: The Laravel API, as php artisan serve.

args.label: -Vite   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: The Vite asset build, as npm run dev.

args.label: -All   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Everything above, which is what a fresh working session usually wants.

args.label: -Stop   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Stop instead of start. With no other switch, stops everything this started.

args.label: -Status   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Say what is running and stop. Nothing is started, stopped or opened.

args.label: -ApiPort   [String]
args.description: The port the API binds, overriding serve.apiPort for this run.

args.label: -VitePort   [String]
args.description: The same for Vite.

secrets.description: Checks and sets up the secrets this repo's commands and GitHub workflows need, as listed in ../secrets.json

args.label: -For   [String]
args.description: Which job to prepare, from secrets.json; omitted lists every secret and changes nothing.

args.label: -Ci   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Never ask: open the sealed archive and fail by name when anything is missing; automatic in GitHub Actions.

args.label: -Seal   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Pack every file and value secrets.json lists into this repo's encrypted archive, ready to upload to the shared folder.

args.label: -OutDir   [String]
args.description: Where -Seal writes the archive; omitted, a folder in Downloads that every repo in the same group seals into.

args.label: -ArchiveFile   [String]
args.description: The sealed archive kept in the repo, gitignored, that -For looks in first, -Import opens and -Export writes; omitted, archive.local in...

args.label: -Import   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Put every file and value the archive in the repo holds where the toolkit reads it, replacing a copy that differs; a file only when its...

args.label: -Export   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Pack this machine's files and values into the archive in the repo, replacing it - after an update, so every other machine can -Import it.

args.label: -GitHub   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Copy each GitHub secret this machine keeps to the clipboard in turn, ready to paste into the repository's settings.

update-database.description: Applies this repository's sql/ folder to the local databases, and runs Laravel's migrations

args.label: -Product   [String[]]
args.description: The products to apply, by sql/ folder; the folders that hold .sql files are offered.

args.label: -AllProducts   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Every product.

args.label: -Step   [String[]]
args.description: The steps to apply, by file name without .sql, or patches; the ones the folders hold are offered.

args.label: -Clear   [String[]]
args.description: Empty tables and keep them, by the sets update-database.json names - all, necessary, non-important; the sets are offered.

args.label: -Drop   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Remove each picked product's database completely; nothing is built back. Takes no -Step or -Migrate.

args.label: -Idempotent   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Bring every database up to date and skip what is already applied, so a second run does nothing.

args.label: -DropAndRecreate   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: -Drop, then -Idempotent: each picked product's database removed, then built up to date - every step, or the -Step ones, and the migrations.

args.label: -Migrate   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: php artisan migrate: additive, and the supported way to update an existing deployment.

args.label: -Preset   [String]
args.description: A named run from update-database.json's presets: the products, steps and switches it sets; what is typed here wins.

args.label: -ConfigFile   [String]
args.description: The settings file; .ikaika_scripts_configs/update-database.json when left out.

args.label: -DryRun   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: List what would run, in order, and run nothing.

check-live.description: Checks that each base's export still matches live Airtable, by record counts

args.label: -Env   [String]
args.description: The bases to count.

copy-to-sql.description: Adopts each generated data.sql into the committed sql/ folder, and records which environment it came from

args.label: -Env   [String]
args.description: Which set of outputs to adopt.

migrate-all.description: Pulls every Airtable base of an environment into SQL: fetch, attachments, data.sql, checks and schema.sql

args.label: -Env   [String]
args.description: The bases to pull: the sandbox ones, or the live ones.

args.label: -Step   [String]
args.description: Where to start: the whole pull, or one part of it again.

reset-local.description: Drops and recreates this PC's portal, estimator and tracker databases, and loads them from sql/

args.label: -Yes   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Skip the question. For a scripted run, where a question is a hang.

verify.description: Checks every generated data.sql against the Airtable export it came from

args.label: -Env   [String]
args.description: Which set of outputs to check.

args.label: -Detailed   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Every table's counts, not only the summary.

admin.description: Builds and deploys the admin API alone to the Test Server

args.label: -Bump   [String]
args.description: same installs this checkout untagged; keep (the next build number only), patch, minor or major release it first.

args.label: -SkipBuild   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Deploy the last build instead of building again.

check-health.description: Checks a server's API: no migration left pending, and its health URL answering

args.label: -Target   [String]
args.description: The server to check.

copy-databases.description: Copies this PC's databases to the Test Server: dumped here, uploaded, imported there

args.label: -Only   [String[]]
args.description: The databases to copy; all four when left out.

args.label: -Wipe   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Empty the Test Server's databases before importing, rather than importing over them.

args.label: -Yes   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Skip the question -Wipe asks. For a scripted run, where a question is a hang.

dump-databases.description: Dumps this PC's databases to deployment/out/db, one .sql each, ready for the Test Server

args.label: -Only   [String[]]
args.description: The databases to dump; all four when left out.

args.label: -MysqldumpPath   [String]
args.description: The mysqldump to use; the one WampServer serves when left out.

import-airtable.description: Replaces production's portal, estimator and tracker databases with the Airtable export

args.label: -SkipGenerate   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Load the SQL generated last time instead of generating it again.

args.label: -Yes   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Skip the question. For a scripted run, where a question is a hang.

production.description: Builds and deploys the admin API and the portal to production, portal.ikaikabim.com/v2

args.label: -Bump   [String]
args.description: What both repos release as: keep takes the next build number only; patch, minor and major bump the version.

args.label: -SkipBuild   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Deploy the released archives as they stand instead of releasing new ones.

args.label: -Yes   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Skip the question. For a scripted release, where a question is a hang.

push-env.description: Pushes the secret settings - Cloudinary, Jira, mail relay and the rest - to a server's .env

args.label: -Target   [String]
args.description: Where the settings go: the Test Server, or production.

args.label: -Only   [String[]]
args.description: The keys to send; every one of them when left out. Not -Keys: the dispatcher reads its own list as .Keys.

args.label: -Yes   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Skip the question production asks. For a scripted run, where a question is a hang.

ssh-key.description: Makes the bluehost SSH alias the deployment scripts use answer without a passphrase, here or on a CI runner

args.label: -Target   [String]
args.description: On a CI runner, the server the alias reaches; at a desk the key is the same for both.

test-server.description: Deploys the secret settings, the admin API and the portal to the Test Server from this PC

args.label: -Bump   [String]
args.description: same installs both checkouts untagged; keep (the next build number only), patch, minor or major release both first.

args.label: -SkipSettings   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Leave the server's secret settings as they are.

args.label: -SkipBuild   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Deploy the last builds instead of building again.

args.label: -ResetDatabases   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Replace every Test Server database with this PC's first; the old data is backed up on the server.

args.label: -Yes   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Skip the question -ResetDatabases asks. For a scripted run, where a question is a hang.

console.description: Opens the Ikaika Console: one window of buttons for the Airtable pull, the Test Server and production

remark-probe.description: Asks an Ollama model to format a remark and checks the answer against the shape the portal stores

args.label: -Remark   [String]
args.description: Your own remark to format; the built-in samples when left out.

args.label: -SelfTest   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Check the checker only; no model is asked.

changelog.description: Release notes by hand, in CHANGELOG.md: under "## Unreleased" for the next release, or under a planned one, "## x.y.z", for a version decided in advance

args.label: -Add   [String[]]
args.description: Commits to file under Unreleased, e.g. 'fix: a crash', each in the section its type names; with -Future, its x.y.z, e.g. 1.5.0.

args.label: -Future   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Notes for a planned release, e.g. -Future -Add 1.5.0: made when missing, then opened in your editor.

args.label: -Edit   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Open CHANGELOG.md in your editor; every save updates CHANGELOG.json until you close it.

args.label: -Check   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Only check CHANGELOG.md the way a build does, exiting 1 on a problem; nothing is changed.

args.label: -Lint   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: List everything that reads badly, by line - empty sections, notes worded like commits, a json behind the file; nothing is changed.

args.label: -Fix   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Mend what -Lint marks (-Fix) and write CHANGELOG.json; what a note says is never changed.

check-all.description: Runs every check that would otherwise be a CI job, and can install itself as a pre-push hook so nothing lands unchecked

args.label: -Full   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Also run the checks.slow.<n> commands - a full web build and anything else too slow to want on every push.

args.label: -ToolkitOnly   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Skip the project checks; toolkit checks only.

args.label: -ProjectOnly   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Skip the toolkit checks; project checks only.

args.label: -InstallHook   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Install (or refresh) the pre-push hook and exit without running anything.

args.label: -UninstallHook   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Remove the pre-push hook and exit.

args.label: -FromHook   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Set by the hook itself. Only changes the closing message, which then explains how to bypass rather than how to push.

manage-tags.description: Manages git tags: creates an annotated tag for a chosen commit (optionally publishing it), renames a tag, and deletes tags picked from a numbered list (optionally on the remote too)

args.label: -Tag   [String[]]
args.description: Tag name(s) for non-interactive use; given alone it implies -Yes.

args.label: -Delete   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Delete mode: pick tags from a list (or the -Tag names) instead of creating.

args.label: -Rename   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Rename mode: give an existing tag a different name.

args.label: -NewName   [String]
args.description: Rename mode: the new name for the tag being renamed.

args.label: -Commit   [String]
args.description: Commit to tag (hash, branch, or any rev git resolves); default HEAD.

args.label: -Message   [String]
args.description: Annotation message; default "Release <tag>".

args.label: -Remote   [String]
args.description: Remote to publish to / delete from.

args.label: -NoPublish   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Create: skip the push. Delete: remove local tags only.

args.label: -Force   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Create: replace an existing tag of the same name (also force-pushes it).

args.label: -ManifestPath   [String]
args.description: Manifest the default tag name is derived from, relative to the repo root.

args.label: -Yes   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Accept every default without prompting (non-interactive mode).

pull-updates.description: Pulls updates from another branch into the branch you are on

run-at-tag.description: Runs one of this project's commands against an already-tagged version, in isolation, without disturbing the current checkout

tag-version.description: Records a build's version in git: files the changelog under it, commits that with the version file, tags it and pushes both - the step build-release's -TagDeploy takes after a build, on its own, so a pipeline can show it as one

args.label: -ManifestPath   [String]
args.description: The file holding the version; version.manifest, else pubspec.yaml, else VERSION, when left out.

args.label: -Remote   [String]
args.description: Where the commit and the tag are pushed.

args.label: -Bump   [String]
args.description: Bump the version file first: patch, minor, major, keep (the next build number only) or an explicit x.y.z.

deploy-release.description: Deploys a built release archive by running the project's own server script on it: the archive and every server script go up together, then the named script runs on the archive in the deploy directory, over SSH

args.label: -ArchivePath   [String]
args.description: The built archive to upload; deploy.archive in ikaika_scripts.env when left out.

args.label: -ScriptsDir   [String]
args.description: The folder of server scripts that go up with every deploy; deploy.scriptsDir when left out.

args.label: -Script   [String]
args.description: The server script to run on the archive, from ScriptsDir; deploy.script when left out.

args.label: -DryRun   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Print what would be uploaded and run, and send nothing.

args.label: -Force   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Skip the confirmation a production deploy asks for.

certificates.description: Every certificate and key this project signs or deploys with, in one place: what there is, what is wrong with it, and what can be done about it - the Android keystores, the Windows code-signing certificates, the SSH deploy key and Expo's...

args.label: -Check   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Exit 1 when a build or deploy would be refused for one - missing, expired, or not the file the repo trusts.

args.label: -Lint   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Every finding, by item: what a build refuses, and what to look at before it does.

args.label: -Fix   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Mend what -Lint marks (-Fix): fetch a missing file from its share.* link, record a checksum never recorded.

args.label: -New   [String]
args.description: Make one that is missing, with the password it is opened with: a keystore, a self-signed code-signing certificate, or the SSH deploy key.

args.label: -Replace   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: With -New, replace one that exists; the old file is kept beside it, since installed copies only update from it.

args.label: -Format   [String]
args.description: With -New on a keystore, its format: PKCS#12, or JKS for a toolchain that cannot read anything else.

args.label: -Convert   [String]
args.description: Move a JKS keystore to PKCS#12, the same key inside; the JKS is kept beside it.

args.label: -Export   [String]
args.description: Write the public half beside it - <file>.pem, or the deploy key's .pub - with its fingerprints.

args.label: -Collect   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Copy every one ready to share into share.uploadDir (share-upload/), with a README of what each is; git must ignore it.

args.label: -Eas   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Open eas credentials, which manages the keys Expo holds for cloud builds.

bump-version.description: Releases THIS toolkit: bumps VERSION, commits it, creates an annotated vX.Y.Z tag and pushes both

args.label: -Bump   [String]
args.description: major, minor, patch, or an explicit x.y.z. Omitted opens the interactive picker, which is also what a double-click gets.

args.label: -NoPublish   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Commit and tag locally, push nothing. For rehearsing a release.

args.label: -Remote   [String]
args.description: Remote to push to.

args.label: -Yes   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Skip the confirmation. For automation; the checks still run.

check-forms.description: Finds every parameter that reaches a front end as a blank box instead of a list

args.label: -Domain   [String]
args.description: Which domain to check. Omitted checks all of them.

args.label: -Strict   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Exit non-zero when a parameter is a text box and the command has not said why.

args.label: -All   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Also list the parameters commands have declared as free text, with nothing to fix.

install-tui.description: Installs or updates the terminal app, on purpose rather than when something notices

args.label: -Force   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Install even when what is already here satisfies tui.version.

args.label: -Prereleases   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Accept a prerelease for this run, whatever tui.prereleases says.

use-version.description: Moves this project onto a specific toolkit version: sets scripts.version in ikaika_scripts.env and checks the submodule out to match

args.label: -Version   [String]
args.description: The version to use: 0.4.2 or v0.4.2. Omitted with -Latest picks the newest tag; omitted without it lists what is available and asks.

args.label: -Latest   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Use the newest tag on the remote.

args.label: -PinOnly   [SwitchParameter]
args.description: Write scripts.version but do not touch the checkout.
